Profile

Educator and creative technologist with over 8 years of experience in generative and interactive media and four years of teaching at NYU, where she designed and taught the undergraduate course Immersivity Beyond the Display, ran the ITP Coding Lab as a Research Fellow, and led workshops on TouchDesigner, Stable Diffusion, Teachable Machine and p5.js. Industry work includes a multi-room interactive rehabilitation system, a real-time generative AI installation at the Venice Biennale '24, and four years building visualization tools for AI research, all of which feed back into the classroom as live examples of how creative technology is practised.
